meta.name: data-governance
meta.description: Establishes ownership, definitions, quality, access, and lineage for the organization's data. Use this when metrics disagree between teams, when nobody knows which dataset is authoritative, when setting up data ownership or access policy, when data quality is unreliable, or before opening a dataset to a wider audience.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理清数据归属与口径,让指标对齐可信
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果团队常为数据口径争吵,却找不到权威数据源
copy.tagline_en: Clarify data ownership and definitions for trustworthy metrics
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team argues over metrics and lacks a trusted data source

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会帮你建立数据治理框架:为业务指标写清定义、计算方式、负责人和已知局限;为数据集指定负责人;设置数据质量检查(新鲜度、行数、唯一性等)与访问权限;并记录数据血缘。
howto.when: 当团队间指标口径不一致、不知哪份数据是权威的、数据质量不可靠等,或需要设定数据治理规则(如所有权、访问策略)时触发;也可在向更广受众开放数据集前使用。

say.text: 帮我为‘月活跃用户’指标写定义:包含计算方式、负责人和已知局限。
say.note: Claude 会生成一条指标字典条目。

say.text: 检查订单表的数据质量:是否按时更新、行数是否正常、关键字段是否唯一。
say.note: Claude 会给出质量检查结果和告警。

say.text: 列出客户数据集的血缘:上游来源和下游消费者分别是什么。

howto.what_en: Claude sets up data governance: metric definitions (plain-language, computation, owner, caveats), dataset owners, data quality checks (freshness, volume, uniqueness), access policies, and lineage.
howto.when_en: Triggers when metrics conflict, no authoritative dataset is known, data quality is unreliable, or when setting ownership/access. Also before opening data to a wider audience.

say_en.text: Define 'monthly active users': computation, owner, caveats.
say_en.note: Claude creates a metric dictionary entry.

say_en.text: Check orders table: freshness, row count, uniqueness of key fields.
Show lineage of customer dataset: upstream sources and downstream consumers.
